title: Lost in the snow: {name}
The pass is not safe
summary: Travellers go missing on the pass {direction} of {settlement}, and the ones found again are found frozen. Something walks out there, {distance} off: {name}. Lay it to rest.
offer: We rang the bell all night and nobody came in. In the morning we found the tracks, and they were not a man's. Something walks the snow {direction} of here, {distance} out. Will you go where we cannot?
progress: The bell rang again last night. Nobody came.
complete: Then the pass is ours again, and the dead can rest. We will pray for them, and for you.
